feeds.title: Who's the Mummy?
feeds.description: Welcome to Who's the Mummy, a blog by journalist and Single Mummy Sally Whittle, and 12-year-old daughter, Flea. This blog is packed with travel tips, activity ideas, parenting hacks and ideas for parents of tweens and teens.

feeds.title: theresilientmum
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to my site, my name is Roxanne-Sasha. I am an Independent mother, currently residing in London with my beautiful daughter.

feeds.title: Inside Martyn's Thoughts
feeds.description: Martyn originally trained as a primary school teacher before becoming a stay-at-home, home educating Dad to his two boys. The blog is a combination of reviews, personal essays and home-ed posts.

feeds.title: Single Mother Ahoy Blog
feeds.description: Covers a mixture of lifestyle, parenting, self development and general ramblings. Single Mother Ahoy is about fun and frolics as a single mother!

feeds.title: Rainbeaubelle
feeds.description: Rainbeau Belle is an amazing writer, who also happens to be a single parent. Julia is a journalist and blogger living in the Yorkshire Dales with her two gorgeous children. The blog offers tips on living well as a single parent with lots of ideas for shopping, eating and living well in Yorkshire.

feeds.title: Was this in the Plan?
feeds.description: Teph is a former marketing consultant who is raising four children in a single parent household since the death of her partner Andy, from cancer. The blog is a rich, inspiring read and provides amazing support for parents facing similar challenges Steph's family includes two children with high-functioning autism and a child with a life-limiting genetic condition

feeds.title: Mum in a Nutshell
feeds.description: Mum, in a Nutshell, is a family lifestyle blog by Devon's single mum. Here, you'll find articles on homes, healthy lifestyles, relationships, single parenting as well as recipes, review and more.

feeds.title: Just-Us-Two.com Blog
feeds.description: The Single Mum blog is where you can find help, information, and entertainment on all things 'single mum'. Readers of Just-Us-Two.com can find answers on the important stuff like benefits, co-parenting, and more!
